mapper.insert: insert into activity_spinwin_lucky_draw_times (activity_id, lucky_draw_times, surplus_draw_times, update_date, user_id, number_of_daily_lottery, user_name) values (#{activityId}, #{luckyDrawTimes}, #{luckyDrawTimes}, now(), #{userId}, #{numberOfDailyLottery}, #{userName})

insert into activity_spinwin_lucky_draw_times (activity_id, user_id, lucky_draw_times, surplus_draw_times, update_date, winning_times, num_sweepstakes_today) values (#{activityId}, #{userId}, #{luckyDrawTimes}, #{surplusDrawTimes}, #{updateDate}, #{winningTimes}, #{numSweepstakesToday})
mapper.select: SELECT time_id, lucky_draw_times, surplus_draw_times, number_of_daily_lottery, winning_times, num_sweepstakes_today FROM activity_spinwin_lucky_draw_times where activity_id = #{param.activityId} and user_id = #{param.userId}
